title: Tip Calculator
description: Calculate tips with different percentages, format currency, and split bills among friends.

steps.title: Calculate tip amount
steps.description: Write a `calcTip` function that takes the bill amount and tip percentage, then returns the tip amount.

steps.title: Format as currency
steps.description: Use `.toFixed(2)` to format the tip amount as a currency string with 2 decimal places.
hints: Use .toFixed(2) to get exactly 2 decimal places
Add a '$' prefix to make it look like currency

verification.failureMessage: Make sure formatCurrency returns a string with 2 decimal places like '$7.50'.

steps.title: Split the bill
steps.description: Write a `splitBill` function that divides the total bill (amount + tip) among a number of people.
hints: Return the amount each person should pay

verification.successMessage: Each person pays $28.75 when splitting a $50 bill with 15% tip between 2 people!

steps.title: Compare tip percentages
steps.description: Calculate tips at 15%, 18%, and 20% for the same bill and show all three options.
hints: Create an array of tip percentages
Loop through each percentage and calculate the tip
Print each result with its percentage label

verification.successMessage: All three tip amounts calculated correctly!

steps.title: Full summary string
steps.description: Create a function that returns a complete summary string with bill amount, tip percentage, tip amount, total, and split details.
hints: Build a string with all the information
Include the bill, tip percent, tip amount, total, and per-person cost
Make it readable like 'Bill: $50.00, Tip: 15% ($7.50), Total: $57.50'

verification.successMessage: Complete summary with all the tip details!
verification.failureMessage: The summary should contain the bill amount, tip percent, tip amount, total, and number of people.
